steps.note: Phantom with the whodunit live: the list names the unlisted cloner, 'Who signed for the case?' sets the bench-log clue, the accusation opens, is taken back once, then confirmed.

said: That case went out with a cloner its sheet doesn't list.
Two names signed for the case.
Kowalczyk and Arakawa. Both signatures are good. The count isn't.
If that's wrong, Netherton loses Phantom till you can clear him. Sure?
Ask me for my list next time. It has two names on it. Neither is mine.
Then I am a pair of hands short. Carry on.
